fact: On 18 February 2020 the UN human rights office gave the security ministry 450 paper A3 registers (custody, procès-verbaux, seals) to fill a shortage in police and gendarmerie posts in Conakry and the interior, and the minister said paper would still be needed for a long time.
title: Sécurité : 450 registres offerts aux officiers de police judiciaire pour garantir le respect des droits des gardés à vue
